text: Reggie's daughter graduates from Leeds on 2 November 2026. He's driving up the day before with his wife. Text him congrats that evening. He was saying she nearly dropped out in second year when her flatmate situation fell apart, so it's a big deal for the whole family. His mum is coming too, first long car trip since her hip. Reggie's buying her a watch, engraved.
lwazi housewarming sat 7ish, new place in walthamstow. bring something non alcoholic, his partner Kerry doesnt drink
Duc said his son starts reception in September 2027 and Duc is already a wreck about it lol

Chat with Marisol after pilates. Her mum's 70th is 14 March 2027, big dinner at a Portuguese place in Stockwell. She's asked me to help with the slideshow beforehand. Her brother Tomás is flying in from Madrid the week before and staying a fortnight. Marisol sounds stressed about hosting, the mum apparently hates fuss. Ask her how it went the next day.
Must ring Sunil before Friday re his dad's surgery.
Thomas and Freya are hosting a bonfire night thing on the 5th. Invited me plus one. I'm bringing sparklers and the mulled wine.
Note to self: return Ryan's drill, it's been in the boot for a month
Ann's grandson Louis has his GCSE results in August 2027. She says he wants to do engineering at Bath.

So um Chloe rang, her little girl Mila lost her first tooth this morning and apparently the tooth fairy is meant to bring a pound coin now, not 20p. Inflation. Anyway Chloe's back at work Monday after the maternity leave and she's nervous about it. Send her a good luck message Sunday night.
Lin's engagement party cancelled, her fiancé's dad is in hospital. Check in with her this week.
barbara - coeliac, also allergic to cashews. dinner at hers 22nd

Mustafa's wedding is 3 July 2027 in Bradford. Save the date came today. Need to book a hotel and ask him what they want for a gift. His fiancée Lin is doing a henna night the Thursday before, and apparently there'll be about 300 guests at the main do. Mustafa said he's more nervous about the speech than the vows. Maybe offer to read his draft a week before.
Kasia passed her driving test!! third attempt. Her dad Emil bought her a little Fiat already
Rhys mentioned Adebayo got into Imperial for the medicine course. Starts October 2027. His mum's been telling everyone.
Bilal said the leaving drinks for his boss are Thursday at the Crown. I said I'd go for one. Afterwards I'm picking up Zofia from the station.
Anjali's twins start secondary school next September. One's going to the grammar, the other isn't, and she says it's caused a bit of tension at home. Don't bring it up unless she does.
Dentist moved to 11 November 2026, 9:15. Take the morning off.
Rory's sister Lila is doing her first marathon in April 2027, London. He wants a group of us to stand at mile 18. Ask him nearer the time where exactly.
dimitri's kids nativity is the 16th dec. he's a shepherd (the kid not dimitri). D's wife Agnieszka doing costumes

Spoke to Chen at the school gates. His eldest is sitting the 11 plus on 14 September and they've been doing practice papers every evening. She's anxious, barely sleeping. Chen thinks they've pushed too hard. Message him that morning to wish her luck, and then a week after to see how she feels.
Kerry's dog Biscuit had his op yesterday, all fine. Kerry is off work till Wednesday looking after him.
Freya's birthday 30 Nov. She's been on about a pasta machine for months. Probably the one from Lakeland.
Remind me to send Duc that photo from the christening.
Louis Walsh (Lou) is running the pub quiz now on Tuesdays. Said he'd save us a table.

Ben's mum passed away on Saturday. Funeral is the 4th, in Swansea. He's struggling. Call him tomorrow, and I should sort flowers for the day before. He said his sister Zofia is handling most of the arrangements but they're not really talking at the moment, which is making everything harder. His kids keep asking where nana went. He sounded exhausted.
Reggie says his wife's planning a surprise 50th for him in May 2027 — he found out by accident and is pretending he doesn't know. Haha.
Anjali and her husband are celebrating twenty years married on 9 December. Going to Lisbon for a long weekend. Their son is staying with Anjali's sister.
gotta get milk, bin bags, and the parcel from the post office before 5
Sunil's dad surgery went fine, home already. Sunil says his dad is grumpy about not driving for six weeks. Pop round with food at the weekend maybe.
Mrs Ito from next door asked if I could feed her cat Mochi while she's in Osaka from 20 October to 2 November 2026. Keys under the plant pot. She'll text the day before she leaves.
Lwazi texted, the housewarming was great apparently but I missed it. Message him to apologise and find out how the new flat's settling.
Kasia's brother Bilal starts at the fire service academy in January 2027. 18 week training course in Moreton. Their mum is proud but worried.
Mila's school play is the 10th, she's a narrator and has been practising her lines on Chloe all week. Ask how it went afterwards.
Ryan's hosting a games night every first Friday. Next one 6 November. He's into Catan and anything with dragons.

Okay so dictating this in the car. Had lunch with Agnieszka and her partner Rhys. Big news, they're expecting, due in late April 2027. Her mum doesn't know yet so keep it quiet. They're also moving to a bigger place in Cheltenham in February. Rhys is a bit freaked out about the mortgage. Congratulate them properly with a card, and offer to help with the move the weekend after.
Thomas Evans (Tom) retires end of March 2027 after 31 years at the council. Party will be at the bowls club. Chip in for the gift.
Lin rang. Her fiancé's dad is out of hospital and recovering. Party rescheduled to 12 December 2026.
Zofia's little one Emil started nursery today and cried for an hour. Zofia cried in the car park apparently. Text her tonight to see how pickup went.
Mustafa's brother Adebayo... no wait, that's Rhys's mate. Mustafa's brother is Dr Ibrahim, the GP. Doing a talk at the library on 25 November.
Uncle Dimitri's 80th, 1 February 2027. Family meal at Kerry's. I'm doing dessert.
Barbara loves gardening, mostly roses. Hates lilies, says they smell like funerals.
don't forget kasia's graduation photos — she wants a copy of the one with her nan

Ann's knee replacement is booked for 3 December. Her daughter Chloe is taking her and staying the night. Ann's nervous, never had a general anaesthetic. Call her the evening before, then pop in the next day with grapes.

Rory's moving out of London end of the year. Sad. Pint before he goes. He and his girlfriend Chloe found a cottage near Stroud with a massive garden, and she's starting a new job at the hospital in Gloucester in January 2027. Rory's going to work remotely. Their dog Pickle will be in heaven. Organise the pint for the week before the van comes.
Duc and his wife hosting Tet in February 2027 again, huge spread. He said last year's was 40 people.
Marisol says Tomás proposed! In Seville. Wedding probably summer 2028.
Ben's daughter Freya got a distinction in her grade 5 piano. Ben is chuffed. Send her a card.
finished the book club book. next meeting the 28th at Lila's
Chen's eldest got into the grammar! Results came this morning. Chen said she screamed. Send congrats.
Mental note — Lwazi's partner Kerry is vegan now, has been since summer. Also does a lot of climbing, bouldering mainly.
Sunil's son Rory graduated from Exeter last summer and is now a junior architect in Bristol. Sunil's very proud, shows everyone the photos.
Reggie asked me to be MC at his daughter's graduation dinner on 2 November 2026. Said yes. Need to write something short and funny, maybe a story from when she was little.
Book the car in for MOT, it's due 15 December.
Tomás nervous about his citizenship test next Thursday. Studying every night. Wish him luck the day before.

Lila (Lils) said her husband Mustafa got made redundant from the bank last week. They're OK for now but she's worried. Her parents offered to help. I should check in with them both in a couple of weeks.

Kasia's 30th - joint party with her boyfriend Louis since his is the same week. 21 November 2026, at their place. Fancy dress, 90s theme. Kasia's been dropping hints about a Polaroid camera, the instant one, and Louis apparently wants nothing except vinyl. Her sister Agnieszka is doing the cake. Need to sort my costume, maybe Spice Girls. Also the day after we're meant to be at Ryan's for Sunday lunch, so pace myself.
Anjali's mum fell, broke her wrist. In plaster six weeks. Anjali's ferrying her to appointments around work.

Just back from Barbara and Thomas's dinner. Lovely evening. Their daughter Mila is doing her PhD in Edinburgh on marine biology, finishes in spring 2027. Barbara makes her own sourdough, said she'd teach me. Thomas is finally retiring in June. Send a thank you text tomorrow morning and ask for the lamb recipe.
Adebayo's results day for his A levels was a disaster, missed his offer by one grade. Going through clearing now. He's gutted. Check in with him on Friday.
Nothing much from the call with Ryan, just catching up. He's good.
